# latency-budget

> Per-stage latency budgets for request pipelines: nearest-rank percentiles per window, unbudgeted time, and alerts with trigger and clear hysteresis Python package `trysac-latency-budget`, import name `latency_budget`, MIT licensed,
> Python >= 3.10, no runtime dependencies.
